_what_this_is: The LockBox integrity manifest. The LockBox slice (2026-08-05 01:00:00Z onward)
can be LOOKED AT ONCE. So a defect inside it that is not labelled before the look
cannot be re-examined without burning the slice — which is what makes an unrecorded
drop categorically worse here than anywhere else in the store.
This file records DEFECTS, not data. Nothing here reveals any market observation:
it says a row was lost, when, from which table, and why. Reading the collector's own
log for integrity events is NOT reading the slice — and if it were forbidden, the
slice's integrity could never be known at all, which would be worse.
It exists because /health's rows_dropped_error is a PROCESS counter: it resets to 0
on the next restart (collector.py:1233, :1734). A defect recorded only there is
erased by the next routine restart. This file survives.
Enforced by tests/test_lockbox_integrity.py: every entry carries every field in
_required_fields, and scripts/lockbox_integrity.py cross-checks the stamped log so
an UNRECORDED drop inside the LockBox window fails loudly.
lockbox_start_note: Moved forward once, from 2026-08-05T00:00:00Z, for a documented data-quality defect
(the cursor=None tape loss) and BEFORE any byte of the slice was read.

defects.cause: ENOSPC. The DuckDB WAL write failed — 'Could not write file "data/ticks/2026-08-05.duckdb.wal": No space left on device' — and the connection was evicted. Root cause is the 12 GB local Vision archive filling the volume to 100 % (593 MiB free at detection), which is itself the residue of the monthly-granularity ingest that also caused the 295-day archive hole.
defects.log_line: 2026-08-05T17:26:26.870Z [collector] DROPPED 1 depth_snapshots row(s) for 2026-08-05: TransactionException('TransactionContext Error: Failed to commit: Could not write file "/Users/azul/Code/btc-quant/data/ticks/2026-08-05.duckdb.wal": No space left on device') — connection evicted; the gap stays a gap
defects.detected_by: The _stamped log fix (commit dc9857b). Before it, 0 of 2,123 log lines carried a timestamp, so this drop would have been known to exist from a /health counter and NOT locatable in time, table, or cause. This is the first production payoff of that fix.
defects.recoverable: NO. depth_snapshots has no historical endpoint at any venue — the book at that second exists nowhere. Unlike the aggTrades loss of 2026-08-03, which the public archive could still witness, this row is simply gone. Gaps stay gaps: no backfill, no interpolation.
defects.consequence: One second of one venue's book is missing from the LockBox. Material impact on any future evaluate-once scoring is [DIASUMSIKAN] negligible — one row against a 1/s cadence — but it is recorded rather than judged, because the slice cannot be re-examined to check.
